// GENERATED FILE — DO NOT EDIT. Source: Tools/DashboardSrc/app.js (menu: SafetyProto → Sync Dashboard Source)
    import { WS_PORT, WS_PATH, CAST_URL } from './js/constants.js';
    import { applyTranslations, toggleLang } from './js/i18n.js';
    import { applyTheme, toggleTheme } from './js/theme.js';
    import { state } from './js/state.js';
    import { renderTasks, closeReportModal, handleRecenterClick } from './js/ui.js';
    import { loadHistory, renderHistory, clearHistory, exportAllHistory } from './js/history.js';
    import { route } from './js/router.js';
    import { WsManager } from './js/ws.js';
    import { EvaluatorViewport } from './js/viewport.js';
    import { SidebarResizeManager } from './js/resize.js';

    /* ── History section wiring ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-export-history').onclick = exportAllHistory;
    document.getElementById('btn-clear-history').onclick  = clearHistory;
    (function () {
      const header  = document.getElementById('history-header');
      const section = document.getElementById('history-section');
      header.onclick = () => {
        const collapsed = section.classList.toggle('collapsed');
        document.getElementById('history-body').classList.toggle('collapsed', collapsed);
        header.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(!collapsed));
      };
      header.onkeydown = e => {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); header.onclick(); }
      };
    })();

    /* ── Close modal (button + backdrop click; Escape handled in _onModalKey) ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-close-modal').onclick = closeReportModal;
    document.getElementById('report-modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === this) closeReportModal();
    });

    /* ── Mobile sidebar toggle ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-menu').onclick = () =>
      document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('open');

    /* ── Optional: open Meta Quest player casting in a side-by-side popup ──
       The casting page sets X-Frame-Options: DENY, so it cannot be embedded;
       a popup on the right half of the screen is the supported alternative.
       Requires the evaluator to be signed in to the same Meta account as the
       headset, with the Quest casting to the browser. */
    let _castWin = null;
    document.getElementById('btn-cast').onclick = () => {
      if (_castWin && !_castWin.closed) { _castWin.focus(); return; }
      const w = Math.min(1100, Math.floor(screen.availWidth * 0.5));
      const h = Math.floor(screen.availHeight * 0.92);
      const left = Math.max(0, screen.availWidth - w);
      _castWin = window.open(CAST_URL, 'spPlayerCast',
        `width=${w},height=${h},left=${left},top=0`);
      if (_castWin) _castWin.focus();
    };

    /* ── Language toggle ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-lang').onclick = () => {
      toggleLang();
      applyTranslations();
      // Re-render dynamic UI in new language
      renderTasks();
      renderHistory();
    };

    /* ── Theme toggle: escuro (uso vivo) ↔ claro (modo figura) ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-theme').onclick = () => {
      toggleTheme();
    };

    document.getElementById('chk-hide-completed').onchange = e => {
      state.hideCompleted = e.target.checked;
      renderTasks();
    };

    /* Activity-log "violations only" filter — CSS-driven, no re-render needed */
    let violationsOnly = false;
    document.getElementById('chk-violations-only').onchange = e => {
      violationsOnly = e.target.checked;
      document.getElementById('log-container').classList.toggle('violations-only', violationsOnly);
    };

    /* ================================================================
     * MAIN ENTRY POINT
     * ============================================================== */
    const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('three-canvas');

    /* Theme before the viewport: its constructor reads the active tokens */
    applyTheme();

    /* Boot 3D viewport */
    const viewport = new EvaluatorViewport(canvasContainer);
    window.__spViewport = viewport;   // acessível aos handlers (evita TDZ)

    /* PoseFrame handler — bypasses router (high-frequency) */
    function handlePoseFrame(p) {
      viewport.updateFrame(p);
    }

    /* Boot sidebar resize manager (needs viewport reference for resize callback) */
    new SidebarResizeManager(
      document.getElementById('sidebar'),
      document.getElementById('resize-handle'),
      viewport,
      { min: 260, max: 700, default: 380 }
    );

    /* Boot WebSocket */
    const ws = new WsManager(
      `ws://${window.location.hostname}:${WS_PORT}${WS_PATH}`,
      envelope => {
        if (envelope.eventType === 'PoseFrame') {
          handlePoseFrame(envelope.payload);
        } else {
          route(envelope);
        }
      }
    );

    ws.connect();
    applyTranslations();
    loadHistory();
    renderHistory();

    /* ── Evaluator recenter control ── */
    document.getElementById('btn-recenter').onclick = () => handleRecenterClick(ws);

    /* Gancho de teste: permite injetar eventos/poses pelo console do
       navegador quando não há headset (ex.: __spRoute({eventType, payload})). */
    window.__spRoute = route;
    window.__spPose  = handlePoseFrame;

    // Signal the load-failure watchdog that the 3D module booted successfully.
    window.__spViewportReady = true;
